name: MusicBrainz + Cover Art Archive
description: Matches artists and albums to MusicBrainz, adds MBIDs, genres, artist descriptions and album covers from the Cover Art Archive. No API key needed. Vibe now has MusicBrainz built in (Server settings → Metadata); this plugin keeps working alongside it.
author: Vibe

settings.label: Contact URL or e-mail for the User-Agent
settings.help: MusicBrainz asks API clients to identify themselves; optional.
